paper.title: All-optical doubly resonant cavities for energy-efficient ReLU function in nanophotonic deep learning

source.caption: (A) Doubly-Resonant Cavity Structure showing the refractive index profile of alternating AlGaAs (n = 3.4) and air (n = 1.0) layers with a central defect region. The carefully engineered structure simultaneously resonates at both fundamental ( ω 1 ) and second-harmonic ( ω 2 = 2 ω 1 ) frequencies. (B) Performance comparison of our approach against existing optical activation technologies, showing the relationship between energy per activation and response time. Our doubly-resonant cavity approach achieves femtojoule-level activation energy with sub-picosecond response time while reducing device footprint by two orders of magnitude compared to previous implementations.
